notes: Posted 7 June 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under '=Starting Stuff-': Court Of The Vile Gangster, Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber, Jabba's Palace: Dungeon, Tatooine: Great Pit Of Carkoon, Prepared Defenses (posted 'Prepared Defense'), Crush The Rebellion, I Will Find Them Quickly, Master and Fanfare; these count toward the 60. No single starting Effect is named, so none is marked.
The section headers '=Starting Stuff-', '-Interrupts/Effects-' and '-Epic Events-' were mis-read as cards and removed.
Fanfare and Come Here You Big Coward are 2001 Effects (Tatooine / Special Edition), not the Reflections III Defensive Shields; counted in the 60.

Posted 'Jabba's Palace Audience Chamber' dested the Dark Jabba's Palace site; 'Tatooine Desert Landing' dested Tatooine: Desert Landing Site; 'Death Star 2 Throne Room' Death Star II: Throne Room; 'Search & Destroy' Search And Destroy; 'Podrace Collision' Podracer Collision; Weapon Levitation the Dark Cloud City interrupt.
The description and strategy call it a Hunt Down The Queen deck, but the posted objective is Court Of The Vile Gangster.
